subject: [PATCH v2 4/8] memcg: remove the soft limit rbtree

2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch removes the soft limit rbtree, a data structure used to track memory usage of cgroups above their limits. With the removal of soft limit reclaim, this tree is no longer needed and its maintenance code can be removed. The patch also drops the last caller of lru_gen_soft_reclaim().
